caption_extra: 昭和十三年中. Printed across two spreads (pp. 308-309 and 310-311); each spread is one wide table: pp. 308/310 hold 總計 and 強盜-竊盜-掏摸 (通貨竝代價) with the 署名 and 順序 columns, pp. 309/311 hold the rest of 掏摸 (有價證券) and 詐欺, 恐喝, 橫領, 其ノ他 and a repeated 順序 column; joined here row by row. Column group headings: 被害 / 罪別. Unit mark 円 printed over the first row. Order of rows as printed: 總計, 刑事部, 市部計, 小計 (first, 麴町-洲崎 rank 1-39), 小計 (second, rank 40-80 品川-東京水上), 郡部計 (rank 1-6), 島嶼計 (rank 1-4). The two 小計 rows are both printed as 小計; 順序 is the 市部 rank 1-80 and a separate 1-6 / 1-4 for 郡部 and 島嶼. The 順序 column is printed twice (left page and right page); given once.
